Let's make sure we are doing this every night.  I think Jason has been 
running the official post id macro most nights, but we need to have the last 
person finished do it every day.  I sure can crank out the emails when I get 
some uninterrupted time to myself!

DG

	From:  Jeffrey C Gossett                           10/20/2000 08:43 AM
	

To: Sally Beck/HOU/ECT@ECT
cc: John J Lavorato/Corp/Enron@Enron, Bob M Hall/NA/Enron@Enron, Leslie 
Reeves/HOU/ECT@ECT (bcc: Darron C Giron/HOU/ECT)
Subject: V@R

Sally -

These are the steps that we have taken to insure that the positions the V@R 
engine picks up are correct:

1. Each book adm. now checks his/her own positions that are going into V@R,  
rather than just one check at  a consolidated level.
2. All regional controllers will receive a sheet at the end of the night, 
verifying that all books are officialized.
